description: [holidays] List the public holidays of one country for one year, e.g. to tell whether a date is a day off or plan around a holiday. Returns entries of date (YYYY-MM-DD), name (English) and localName (in the country's language). Weekends are not listed. Returns an error for a country Nager.Date does not cover; for mainland China make-up workdays (调休) use holidaycn_year instead.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code in capitals, e.g. 'US', 'DE', 'TR'

name: holidays_list
title: Public holidays: list
